limitations: Home-base bias is not a hard distance cutoff and cannot guarantee every moon is occupied before combat. No impossible fixed mining count is imposed on maps with few moons.
Native trade route selection rejects enemy stations; allied-route formation requires compatible stations in the match. AIP lists cannot condition cargo construction on ally presence.
Borg has no native trading station; its existing assimilated economy branch is retained. 8472 has no native colony/trade system.
Generic strategic AIPs are shared defaults; campaign-specific build lists are not edited.
